title: Isandro and the Lantern
author: Wendell Montrose
blurb: Rosalind Amberdale, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
